name: pop
description: 2D · pale and saturated slides alternate, heavy centred headline, flat phone in a thick bezel that flips colour with the slide, some slides tilted in the plane.
design_notes: Friendly consumer look. Slides alternate between a pale tint (headline in the brand colour, bezel in the brand colour) and the saturated brand colour (white headline, white bezel). Very heavy, large, centred headline; the phone is flat with a thick bezel and sometimes tilted a few degrees in the plane. No decoration.
